      line-height: 22px;
      margin-left: 0.5em;
      opacity: 0.95;
      white-space: pre;

    }

      height: 22px;
      margin-left: 5px;
    }

    .filled-circle {
      margin-right: 3px;
      opacity: 0.4;
    }

    .decoration-text {

      font-weight: 600;
      margin-right: 3px;
      opacity: 0.75;
    }

      background-color: var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground);
      color: var(--vscode-list-hoverForeground);
